The moment the cost of the beans goes up, the store price tag does not jump up and say, got it! Price rises take time to show up. In other words, a price tag is not a live news broadcast. It is a letter that arrives a little late. Even if you open it today, it may not be about something that happened today. It may tell you about an earlier drought or bean shortage or high prices in the market. If you look only at the latest headline, you may get the sender wrong.
